geckolib_constant_resource_reuse.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the 1-argument getter call inside GeoModel.getModelResource(T, GeoRenderer), getTextureResource(T, GeoRenderer) and getAnimation(T, String): for a model class whose dispatched getter is proven from its bytecode (javac bridge with checkcast + typed getter returning new ResourceLocation of two string constants, or since 1.0.49 ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath of two string constants while that factory is Forge's own constructor call and no mixin replaces it; no mixin merged into either class) the first result is handed out again when the argument is null or of the bridge's type; every other call runs the original (helper bons.furious.patch.geckolib_constant_resources.ConstantResources: runtime flag, SHADOW mode)

geckolib_texture_template_memo.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the 1-argument texture getter call inside GeoModel.getTextureResource(T, GeoRenderer): for a model class whose typed texture getter is proven from its bytecode to be MCreator's template new ResourceLocation(ns, prefix + arg.getTexture() + suffix) (one string concatenation, behind the javac bridge, no mixin merged into the model classes) and an argument whose dispatched getTexture() is the plain synched-data read (proven per class from its bytecode), the location kept for an equal texture string is handed out again (at most 64 strings per model class); a first string runs the original and keeps its result only when it is exactly that string's location; every other call runs the original (helper bons.furious.patch.geckolib_constant_resources.ConstantResources: runtime flag, SHADOW mode)
